name: Camera pulls back over a tilted field of projects
looks: A single project card fills the frame, then the camera pulls back and tilts down to reveal it is one of many tilted, overlapping cards scattered across a dark grid, each a different small app or dashboard, with a short headline settling over the expanse.
build: gallery-zoom-tour: the pseudo-camera's focus and log-scale zoom out reveal the full tilted field, each card a flat plane at a slight independent rotation; the headline fades in last, once the pull-back settles.
sound: A soft shift under the pull-back, with a low ambient bed once it settles.
prompt: Prove a platform hosts many different projects: start tight on one, then pull the camera back and tilt down to reveal it as one of a large, loosely scattered field of distinct projects, closing on a short headline once the full scale is visible.
